Messages.Author: Pirkka Hartikainen
Messages.Body:
Q: Can you play Giant's Blood on an _uncontrolled_ vampire?


It's quite a strong card if you can bring a 10-blood heavy-hitter
in on the first round - without paying a single pool!

The card text does not restrict the target vampire choice in any way...
is it a mistake? Any house rulings / official answers appreciated,
thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: Paul Jensen
Messages.Body:
Pirkka Hartikainen (pirkka@freeport.uwasa.fi) wrote:

: Q: Can you play Giant's Blood on an _uncontrolled_ vampire?


: It's quite a strong card if you can bring a 10-blood heavy-hitter
: in on the first round - without paying a single pool!

: The card text does not restrict the target vampire choice in any way...
: is it a mistake? Any house rulings / official answers appreciated,
: thanks in advance.

Well this is not an official ruling, but I was always under the impression
that no non-ready or uncontrolled vampires could use ANY card unless it
speciffically says otherwise.  I think this is much easier, and makes more
sense, then expecting each card to disclaim effecting uncontrolled vampires.

Messages.Author: Thomas Doehne
Messages.Body:
In article <373h5f$e7u@apollo.it.luc.edu> 
pjensen@orion.it.luc.edu (Paul Jensen) writes:
>Pirkka Hartikainen (pirkka@freeport.uwasa.fi) wrote:
>: Q: Can you play Giant's Blood on an _uncontrolled_ vampire?


>Well this is not an official ruling, but I was always under the impression
>that no non-ready or uncontrolled vampires could use ANY card unless it
>speciffically says otherwise.  I think this is much easier, and makes more
>sense, then expecting each card to disclaim effecting uncontrolled vampires.

Rulings on Minion Tap and Blood doll made it clear that Master cards
can be played on vampires in torpor.  However, you can't play Master
cards on *any* uncontrolled vampires.  So, you can play them on
ready vampires, and vampires in torpor, unless the card restricts
or allows you otherwise.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Master cards cannot be played on uncontrolled vampires unless they
specifically say so (e.g., Brainwash).  In general, only effects
which specifically talk about uncontrolled vampires can interact
with them.
